payload.text: {"summary":"Curation of apps/geckoterminal via the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker skill is complete and verified. The tool layer (apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs) contains 11 user-centric tools distilled from 20 mechanical endpoint stubs, centered on the price-data user story: geckoterminal_get_token_price (batch spot prices for up to 30 tokens with 24h change/volume/mcap), geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv (OHLCV price/volume history with day/hour/minute timeframes), geckoterminal_get_token (composite: token profile plus top pools in one call), geckoterminal_search_pools (resolves token symbols/pairs to pool addresses for follow-up calls), geckoterminal_get_pool (full pool stats incl. buy/sell volume breakdown and liquidity), geckoterminal_get_pool_trades (last-24h trades, filterable to whale-size via min_volume_usd), geckoterminal_get_trending_pools, geckoterminal_get_top_pools, geckoterminal_get_new_pools, geckoterminal_check_token_safety (GT score, honeypot flag, holder concentration, mint/freeze authority), and geckoterminal_list_networks (network/DEX ID discovery). Dropped endpoints: pool token info (overlaps safety check), recently-updated token metadata (niche), multi-token data (overlaps batch price). All tools are verb-led with 'Use when…' descriptions and ≤5 args each; defaults (24h trending window, USD OHLCV currency, volume-sort, base_token/quote_token/dex hydration) are computed in Rust rather than exposed. The PREAMBLE in lib.rs is domain-specific and reconciled with the shipped tool list: conventions (GeckoTerminal network slugs, string-typed numeric fields, ~10 calls/min public rate limit, JSON:API response shape), workflow guidance (search→address→deep-dive chaining; combine pool stats + OHLCV + trades for analysis; offer safety check before acting on unfamiliar tokens), and formatting rules. Verification: cargo build passes clean, and a live-API smoke test confirmed both the simple token_price endpoint (WETH at $1842.73 with 24h volume/change fields matching the client's assumptions) and the networks endpoint. test.json already held a user_story seed ('Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one: its current price, 24h volume and liquidity, and any recent trades over $10k') and was preserved per skill policy. No ext/ edits were required — the app uses an app-local spec (apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml) and generated client (src/client/), and the API is fully public with no auth shim.","changedFiles":"apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs, apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs, apps/geckoterminal/test.json, apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml, apps/geckoterminal/openapi.preprocessed.yaml, apps/geckoterminal/src/client/ (generated), apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.toml, apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.lock (all new/untracked in the working tree; no ext/ files touched since the app uses an app-local client)","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand the test.json seed into a full multi-turn e2e spec and run the harness. Optionally smoke-chat via aomi-run target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib to sanity-check tool naming and PREAMBLE wording interactively. Consider a spec-trim pass (drop UI-only fields like image_url from openapi.yaml response schemas, then aomi-build gen-client --force) if e2e runs show noisy tool outputs."}
